never a CV agency.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Frequently Asked
Questions.

Straightforward answers covering our one-company-per-sector exclusivity, cross-sector coverage, coaching and connected AI services.

Do you offer sector exclusivity — and what does “one company per sector” mean?

Yes. We work with one organisation per agreed UK sector and territory at a time. Choosing Power-Up Talent means we protect your market position in writing and do not headhunt for your named competitors during your partnership. Check availability on our Sector & Territory Exclusivity page.

Do you specialise in one industry, or work across all UK sectors?

We are not limited to a single industry or niche. We partner with ambitious organisations across any UK commercial, operational or executive sector — our methodology is built around competitor mapping, leadership vetting and commercial execution in your market.

How is confidentiality maintained during a senior or passive search?

Every mandate runs under bilateral NDA protocols. We never publish client identities on job boards or approach a candidate’s employer without consent, protecting both client strategy and candidate confidentiality.

Can we engage Power-Up Talent for headhunting alone, or add coaching and AI services later?

Yes. Many clients start with a single critical search (Headhunting) and add leadership coaching (Coaching) or any of our seven AI & business platforms as their business grows.

How do the seven AI & business platforms fit alongside your people services?

Each of the seven platforms is a separate, human-controlled operational tool covering Sales & Intelligence, Business & Personal CRM, Shared Communications, Business Delivery, Approval Studio, AI Team Research Workbench and Marketing Attribution. Explore them on the AI Business Services hub.
